title: A2A connections
description: Exchange tasks, progress and results with local and external Agents in this project.
keywords: A2A external agent connection collaboration authentication task
noProject: Open a project to configure its A2A connections.
empty: Add an A2A 1.0 compatible Agent service to extend collaboration in this project.
checkHint: Check reads the Agent Card. Save the connection to make it available to the current Agent.
toolsHint: Ask your current Agent to discover A2A connections and send your task. It can read progress and results, provide follow-up input or request cancellation.
removeHint: Deleting invalidates this connection's local requests and task handles. Tasks already accepted by the remote Agent require a separate cancellation request.

credential.stored: A credential is stored; its original value is never returned to this form.
credential.keepHint: Keeping a credential requires the same authentication type, Header and target origin. Enter a new credential when changing the target.
credential.clearHint: After saving, configure a credential again before calling an authenticated service.

field.name: Connection name
field.cardHint: Enter the full HTTPS Agent Card URL. Local loopback services can use HTTP.
field.interfaceHint: Leave empty to use the first compatible Card interface. Explicitly select interfaces on a different origin, then check again.
field.interfaceTenantHint: Set the tenant declared by the Card when several interfaces share one URL; empty selects the first match.
field.headerHint: For example, X-API-Key. Only Header API-keys are supported.
field.secretHint: The host stores the credential securely and sends it only to the explicitly configured target.

discovery.title: Agent Card check result
discovery.chooseInterface: Selecting an interface re-checks the connection automatically.
discovery.cardHint: The Agent declares its name, version and skills. Tasks run through the saved connection.

validation.name: Enter a connection name of 1–120 characters.
validation.url: Enter an HTTPS URL without user information or a fragment. HTTP is supported only for local loopback.
validation.tenant: An interface tenant requires an explicit interface URL and at most 512 bytes.
validation.header: Enter a valid custom Header name that does not override authentication, version or HTTP transport headers.
validation.keep: The target or authentication changed. Enter a new credential.
validation.secret: Enter a credential of 1–8192 printable ASCII characters without whitespace.

errors.A2A_AGENT_SESSION_INVALID: The Agent session ended and its result was discarded. Reconnect from an active session.
errors.A2A_AGENT_SESSION_REQUIRED: This operation requires an active Belfry Agent connection.
errors.A2A_API_UNSUPPORTED: This A2A operation is not implemented.
errors.A2A_ARGUMENT_INVALID: Invalid A2A arguments. Use the parameters in the tool directory.
errors.A2A_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: Configure the credential required by this connection.
errors.A2A_AUTHENTICATION_UNSUPPORTED: This Agent requires an unsupported authentication flow or multiple credentials.
errors.A2A_AUTH_HEADER_INVALID: The API-key Header is invalid or conflicts with authentication, version or transport headers.
errors.A2A_CONNECTION_CHANGED: The connection changed during the request. Its old result was discarded.
errors.A2A_CONNECTION_INVALID: The connection name or ID is invalid. Names allow up to 120 characters.
errors.A2A_CONNECTION_LIMIT: Connection limit reached: 32 per project and 256 in total.
errors.A2A_CONNECTION_NOT_FOUND: This connection is unavailable in the current project. Refresh the list.
errors.A2A_CREDENTIAL_INVALID: Credentials require 1–8192 printable ASCII characters without whitespace.
errors.A2A_CREDENTIAL_KEEP_INVALID: The target or authentication changed. Explicitly replace or clear the credential.
errors.A2A_CREDENTIAL_ORIGIN_MISMATCH: The selected interface does not match the credential origin. Reconfigure it.
errors.A2A_HISTORY_LIMIT: History length must be between 0 and 20.
errors.A2A_HTTP_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: The Agent rejected authentication or access. Check the credential configuration.
errors.A2A_HTTP_ERROR: The Agent returned an HTTP error.
errors.A2A_HTTP_UNAVAILABLE: The A2A network client could not be initialized.
errors.A2A_INTERFACE_CHANGED: The Agent Card changed the task interface. The existing task was not forwarded to another endpoint.
errors.A2A_INTERFACE_SELECTION_REQUIRED: The Card points to an interface on a different origin. Select it explicitly and check again.
errors.A2A_INVALID_CARD: The Agent Card does not have the required A2A 1.0 format.
errors.A2A_INVALID_RESPONSE: The Agent returned an invalid A2A 1.0 response.
errors.A2A_MESSAGE_INVALID: Enter non-empty task text of at most 64 KiB in UTF-8.
errors.A2A_MODES_UNSUPPORTED: The Agent does not declare compatible text input and text or JSON output.
errors.A2A_NETWORK_ERROR: The Agent service could not be reached or read. Check its address and the network.
errors.A2A_NO_COMPATIBLE_INTERFACE: The Card does not offer the selected JSONRPC / 1.0 interface.
errors.A2A_OPERATION_FAILED: The A2A host operation could not finish. Try again.
errors.A2A_PROJECT_INVALID: The project directory is unavailable. Open a valid project.
errors.A2A_REDIRECT_REJECTED: The service returned a redirect. Explicitly configure the final trusted URL.
errors.A2A_REMOTE_TASK_NOT_FOUND: The remote Agent could not find this task.
errors.A2A_REQUEST_CANCELED: The local A2A request stopped. Remote tasks require a separate cancellation request.
errors.A2A_REQUEST_CONFLICT: This request ID is already in use. Create a new request.
errors.A2A_REQUEST_ID_INVALID: The A2A request ID is invalid. Use a new independent request identifier.
errors.A2A_REQUEST_LIMIT: Pending requests or cancellation records reached their limit. Try again later.
errors.A2A_REQUIRED_EXTENSION_UNSUPPORTED: This Card requires an A2A extension the client does not support.
errors.A2A_RESPONSE_LIMIT: The Agent response is too large to return. Read a single task or message, or reduce history.
errors.A2A_RESPONSE_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED: The JSON-RPC client requires an application/json response. This response type is unsupported.
errors.A2A_RPC_ERROR: The remote Agent returned a JSON-RPC error.
errors.A2A_SETTINGS_ACCESS_DENIED: Manage connections through project A2A in the main application window.
errors.A2A_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: A2A connection or credential storage is unavailable. Check the system key service and application data directory.
errors.A2A_TASK_HANDLE_INVALID: This task handle is not available to the current project, connection or Agent instance, or it expired when the application restarted.
errors.A2A_TASK_LIMIT: The local task-handle limit was reached. No new message was sent.
errors.A2A_TASK_NOT_CANCELABLE: The remote Agent explicitly rejected cancellation of this task.
errors.A2A_URL_INVALID: Use an HTTPS URL without credentials or a fragment. HTTP is supported only for local loopback.
errors.A2A_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED: The remote response declares an incompatible A2A protocol version.
errors.outcomeUnknown: The send outcome is unknown and the remote Agent may have accepted the task. Check before deciding to resend.
errors.A2A_LOCAL_UNAVAILABLE: The local A2A adapter is unavailable. Use the updated desktop host and reopen the session.
errors.A2A_LOCAL_AGENT_NOT_FOUND: The target Agent is not ready or its instance changed. Discover local Agents again.
errors.A2A_LOCAL_TASK_CHANGED: The task generation or ownership changed. Read the current assignment before continuing.
errors.A2A_LOCAL_TASK_NOT_FOUND: This task is unavailable to the current instance. Read the local task list.
errors.A2A_LOCAL_PERMISSION_OR_STATE: The current role, project or task state does not allow this operation. Refresh the room context.
errors.A2A_LOCAL_TASK_LIMIT: The local protocol task limit was reached. Try again later.
errors.A2A_LOCAL_OPERATION_CONFLICT: This operation identifier was used with different content. Read the current task or room first.
errors.A2A_LOCAL_CONTEXT_NOT_FOUND: This protocol context is unavailable to the current project or caller instance.
errors.A2A_LOCAL_ROOM_AMBIGUOUS: These Agents share multiple rooms. Specify the room through the room task tool.
errors.A2A_LOCAL_REPORT_INVALID: Invalid explicit report. Use the current handle and generation with the required explanation or text artifacts.
errors.A2A_TEXT_INVALID: The text is invalid or exceeds the allowed size.
